## Activity

During August 2025, Harbour Eye Clinic completed 35 captures. This report records the activity undertaken during the month and summarises the subsequent image quality and grading outcomes. The available results indicate that image capture continued as part of the clinic’s routine service delivery. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave.

## Image quality

Of the 35 captures, 4 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 11.4 per cent. These images could not be used for grading, and the result is recorded separately from the images that proceeded through the grading process. The image-quality outcome should be monitored as part of routine review, with attention given to maintaining consistently suitable images for assessment.

## Grading

There were 11 referable results during the month. The median grading lag was 1 day. This indicates that grading was generally completed promptly for the images received, while referable outcomes were identified for appropriate follow-up under established arrangements. The activity, image-quality and grading figures provide the operational summary for Harbour Eye Clinic for August 2025.
